people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
translations.bsb: and said to the whole congregation of Israel, “The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.
translations.kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
translations.asv: and they spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
